documentation.content:
DRAFT, not applied. Ron approves creating it (#2106).

Fires when the prod CDN (`toast-stats-cdn-url-map`, cdn.taverns.red) serves more than 5 GiB in one hour. On 2026-10-13 a local CORS proxy that dropped `Range` pulled 28 GiB of basemap in a few hours; normal traffic is well under 1 GiB/hour.

First check: `http_load_balancer` request logs for the last hour, grouped by client IP and path; look for 200 (non-206) GETs of `/basemap/**.pmtiles`. Local verification must use `scripts/dev/cdn-cors-proxy.mjs`.

Apply (after adding notificationChannels):

    gcloud monitoring policies create --project=toast-stats-prod-6d64a --policy-from-file=infra/monitoring/cdn-response-bytes-alert.json

conditions.displayName: CDN response bytes summed over 1 hour > 5 GiB
